name: Advanced Library
description: Your library is vast enough to contain useful, direct information about supernatural topics. Choose a topic per Advanced Library dot. Every story, once per topic, you can take the Informed Condition when you consult your library about that topic.
descriptionEn: Your library is vast enough to contain useful, direct information about supernatural topics. Choose a topic per Advanced Library dot. Every story, once per topic, you can take the Informed Condition when you consult your library about that topic.

name: Area of Expertise
description: Raise one Specialty's die bonus to +2.
descriptionEn: Raise one Specialty's die bonus to +2.

name: Common Sense
description: Once per chapter, roll Wits + Composure as an instant action to ask the Storyteller a question about risks and choices.
descriptionEn: Once per chapter, roll Wits + Composure as an instant action to ask the Storyteller a question about risks and choices.

name: Danger Sense
description: +2 bonus to detect an ambush.
descriptionEn: +2 bonus to detect an ambush.

name: Direction Sense
description: Keep perfect track of your relative location and direction, and ignore penalties to navigate or find your way.
descriptionEn: Keep perfect track of your relative location and direction, and ignore penalties to navigate or find your way.

name: Eidetic Memory
description: Ignore rolls for recall or memory. +2 bonus to recall minute facts buried in other information.
descriptionEn: Ignore rolls for recall or memory. +2 bonus to recall minute facts buried in other information.

name: Encyclopedic Knowledge
description: Roll Intelligence + Wits to recall useful trivia relating to a particular field or pursuit.
descriptionEn: Roll Intelligence + Wits to recall useful trivia relating to a particular field or pursuit.

name: Eye for the Strange
description: Roll Intelligence + Composure to identify evidence of supernatural involvement.
descriptionEn: Roll Intelligence + Composure to identify evidence of supernatural involvement.

name: Fast Reflexes
description: Add Fast Reflexes dots to Initiative.
descriptionEn: Add Fast Reflexes dots to Initiative.

name: Good Time Management
description: Make extended action rolls in half the necessary time.
descriptionEn: Make extended action rolls in half the necessary time.

name: Holistic Awareness
description: Roll Wits + Survival to substitute woodland scavengings for equipment when treating patients with Medicine, unless the patient suffers non-bashing wound penalties.
descriptionEn: Roll Wits + Survival to substitute woodland scavengings for equipment when treating patients with Medicine, unless the patient suffers non-bashing wound penalties.

name: Indomitable
description: +2 to a contesting dice pool or resistance trait applied against supernatural mental influence.
descriptionEn: +2 to a contesting dice pool or resistance trait applied against supernatural mental influence.

name: Interdisciplinary Specialty
description: Choose a Specialty in the corresponding Skill. Apply the Specialty's bonus die to relevant rolls of any Skill, except unskilled rolls.
descriptionEn: Choose a Specialty in the corresponding Skill. Apply the Specialty's bonus die to relevant rolls of any Skill, except unskilled rolls.

name: Investigative Aide
description: When you roll the selected Skill to uncover clues, achieve exceptional success with only three successes. Add a bonus element to any clues uncovered with this Skill.
descriptionEn: When you roll the selected Skill to uncover clues, achieve exceptional success with only three successes. Add a bonus element to any clues uncovered with this Skill.

name: Investigative Prodigy
description: When you roll to uncover clues, you uncover a clue per success, capped by your dots in Investigative Prodigy. Clues from extra successes never have more than one element each.
descriptionEn: When you roll to uncover clues, you uncover a clue per success, capped by your dots in Investigative Prodigy. Clues from extra successes never have more than one element each.

name: Language
description: You can speak, read and write in a chosen language.
descriptionEn: You can speak, read and write in a chosen language.

name: Library
description: You have a cache of information relating to a particular Skill. Add your dots in Library to relevant extended rolls.
descriptionEn: You have a cache of information relating to a particular Skill. Add your dots in Library to relevant extended rolls.

name: Lucid Dreamer
description: You may roll Resolve + Composure while asleep to dream lucidly, and may wake up at will.
descriptionEn: You may roll Resolve + Composure while asleep to dream lucidly, and may wake up at will.

name: Meditative Mind
description: Ignore environmental and wound penalties on meditation rolls. With two dots, meditation grants +3 to Resolve + Composure rolls for the remainder of the day. With four dots, meditation rolls only need to accumulate one success.
descriptionEn: Ignore environmental and wound penalties on meditation rolls. With two dots, meditation grants +3 to Resolve + Composure rolls for the remainder of the day. With four dots, meditation rolls only need to accumulate one success.

name: Multilingual
description: For each dot, choose two languages you can speak conversationally. Roll Intelligence + Academics for reading comprehension.
descriptionEn: For each dot, choose two languages you can speak conversationally. Roll Intelligence + Academics for reading comprehension.

name: Object Fetishism
description: You obsess over a given possession relating to a chosen Specialty. Recover Willpower each session from your obsession, and spending Willpower to roll that Specialty exaggerates both failure and success.
descriptionEn: You obsess over a given possession relating to a chosen Specialty. Recover Willpower each session from your obsession, and spending Willpower to roll that Specialty exaggerates both failure and success.

name: Patient
description: Add +2 to your maximum number of allowed rolls on extended actions.
descriptionEn: Add +2 to your maximum number of allowed rolls on extended actions.

name: Scarred
description: Suffer a Persistent Condition which prevents you from recovering Integrity, but inures you from a particular breaking point.
descriptionEn: Suffer a Persistent Condition which prevents you from recovering Integrity, but inures you from a particular breaking point.

name: Tolerance for Biology
description: Ignore Resistance rolls from witnessing biological grotesquerie.
descriptionEn: Ignore Resistance rolls from witnessing biological grotesquerie.

name: Trained Observer
description: Take 9-Again, or 8-Again with three dots, on Perception rolls.
descriptionEn: Take 9-Again, or 8-Again with three dots, on Perception rolls.

name: Vice-Ridden
description: Take a second Vice.
descriptionEn: Take a second Vice.

name: Virtuous
description: Take a second Virtue.
descriptionEn: Take a second Virtue.

name: Ambidextrous
description: Ignore offhand penalties. Character creation only.
descriptionEn: Ignore offhand penalties. Character creation only.

name: Automotive Genius
description: Raise maximum modifications to a vehicle to thrice Crafts rating, plus number of relevant Crafts Specialties.
descriptionEn: Raise maximum modifications to a vehicle to thrice Crafts rating, plus number of relevant Crafts Specialties.

name: Covert Operative
description: When launching an ambush, deny 10-Again to notice it, and take +3 Initiative on the first turn.
descriptionEn: When launching an ambush, deny 10-Again to notice it, and take +3 Initiative on the first turn.

name: Crack Driver
description: When not taking any non-Drive actions, add your Composure as a bonus to Drive rolls, and penalize attempts to disable your vehicle by your Composure. With three dots, you can take a reflexive Drive action once per turn.
descriptionEn: When not taking any non-Drive actions, add your Composure as a bonus to Drive rolls, and penalize attempts to disable your vehicle by your Composure. With three dots, you can take a reflexive Drive action once per turn.

name: Demolisher
description: When breaking objects, ignore a point of Durability per dot of Demolisher.
descriptionEn: When breaking objects, ignore a point of Durability per dot of Demolisher.

name: Double Jointed
description: Dislodge joints at will. Escape from mundane bondage automatically. When grappled and not acting aggressively, penalize your attacker's overpowering rolls by your Dexterity.
descriptionEn: Dislodge joints at will. Escape from mundane bondage automatically. When grappled and not acting aggressively, penalize your attacker's overpowering rolls by your Dexterity.

name: Fleet of Foot
description: Add dots in Fleet of Foot to your Speed, and penalize pursuit rolls in a foot chase by your Fleet of Foot dots.
descriptionEn: Add dots in Fleet of Foot to your Speed, and penalize pursuit rolls in a foot chase by your Fleet of Foot dots.

name: Giant
description: +1 Size. Character creation only.
descriptionEn: +1 Size. Character creation only.

name: Greyhound
description: Succeed exceptionally on three successes in a chase action.
descriptionEn: Succeed exceptionally on three successes in a chase action.

name: Hardy
description: Add Hardy dots as a bonus to rolls against disease, poison, deprivation, suffocation and unconsciousness.
descriptionEn: Add Hardy dots as a bonus to rolls against disease, poison, deprivation, suffocation and unconsciousness.

name: Iron Stamina
description: Ignore penalties from fatigue or wounds up to your rating in Iron Stamina.
descriptionEn: Ignore penalties from fatigue or wounds up to your rating in Iron Stamina.

name: Punch Drunk
description: Spend Willpower to preserve your last Health point, upgrading preexisting damage instead.
descriptionEn: Spend Willpower to preserve your last Health point, upgrading preexisting damage instead.

name: Quick Draw
description: Whenever your Defense is available, you can draw a weapon that falls under a chosen Weaponry or Firearms Specialty as a reflexive action.
descriptionEn: Whenever your Defense is available, you can draw a weapon that falls under a chosen Weaponry or Firearms Specialty as a reflexive action.

name: Relentless
description: Add 2 to the successes needed against you in a chase.
descriptionEn: Add 2 to the successes needed against you in a chase.

name: Roadkill
description: When you try to run someone over, Knock Down even if you miss, and double your velocity bonus.
descriptionEn: When you try to run someone over, Knock Down even if you miss, and double your velocity bonus.

name: Seizing the Edge
description: You get the Edge in the first turn of a chase, and if your opponent fails a roll as if being ambushed, you can calculate your target successes without their Speed or Initiative.
descriptionEn: You get the Edge in the first turn of a chase, and if your opponent fails a roll as if being ambushed, you can calculate your target successes without their Speed or Initiative.

name: Sleight of Hand
description: You can take a Larceny instant action reflexively once per turn, and victims of your Larceny can't notice your attempts if they aren't specifically looking for them.
descriptionEn: You can take a Larceny instant action reflexively once per turn, and victims of your Larceny can't notice your attempts if they aren't specifically looking for them.

name: Small-Framed
description: -1 Size. Take a +2 bonus to hide, go unnoticed, or otherwise benefit from your size. Character creation only.
descriptionEn: -1 Size. Take a +2 bonus to hide, go unnoticed, or otherwise benefit from your size. Character creation only.

name: Survivalist
description: You can resist Extreme Cold and Extreme Heat for hours equal to your Stamina.
descriptionEn: You can resist Extreme Cold and Extreme Heat for hours equal to your Stamina.

name: Air of Menace
description: You wear a history of violence on your sleeve. +2 to menace others, and less rough characters must spend Willpower to pick a fight, but social maneuvering is harder.
descriptionEn: You wear a history of violence on your sleeve. +2 to menace others, and less rough characters must spend Willpower to pick a fight, but social maneuvering is harder.

name: Allies
description: You have influence and goodwill with a chosen group proportional to your dots in this Merit. Each session, you can call on your Allies for favors of a value rated 1 to 5 by the Storyteller, up to your rating in the Merit. Favors in excess require a roll of Manipulation + Persuasion + Allies.
descriptionEn: You have influence and goodwill with a chosen group proportional to your dots in this Merit. Each session, you can call on your Allies for favors of a value rated 1 to 5 by the Storyteller, up to your rating in the Merit. Favors in excess require a roll of Manipulation + Persuasion + Allies.

name: Alternate Identity
description: You've laid groundwork establishing a false identity: an informal history with one dot, a veneer of documentation with two, or an airtight paper trail with three. +1 to Subterfuge rolls to maintain the false identity, or +2 with three dots.
descriptionEn: You've laid groundwork establishing a false identity: an informal history with one dot, a veneer of documentation with two, or an airtight paper trail with three. +1 to Subterfuge rolls to maintain the false identity, or +2 with three dots.

name: Anonymity
description: Penalize attempts to find you by paper trail or living evidence by a die per Anonymity dot.
descriptionEn: Penalize attempts to find you by paper trail or living evidence by a die per Anonymity dot.

name: Barfly
description: You can get in anywhere socially. Penalize attempts to recognize you as out of place by your Socialize dots.
descriptionEn: You can get in anywhere socially. Penalize attempts to recognize you as out of place by your Socialize dots.

name: Closed Book
description: Add dots in this Merit to your number of Doors, and as a die bonus to contest Social assessment actions.
descriptionEn: Add dots in this Merit to your number of Doors, and as a die bonus to contest Social assessment actions.

name: Cohesive Unit
description: Confer +2 to teamwork. With two dots, confer bonus dice each scene. With three dots, confer rerolls.
descriptionEn: Confer +2 to teamwork. With two dots, confer bonus dice each scene. With three dots, confer rerolls.

name: Contacts
description: Choose a group or field for each dot of Contacts. You can roll Manipulation + (relevant Social Skill) to gather information or dirt from acquaintances in any of these groups or fields.
descriptionEn: Choose a group or field for each dot of Contacts. You can roll Manipulation + (relevant Social Skill) to gather information or dirt from acquaintances in any of these groups or fields.

name: Defender
description: Gain bonus Willpower to spend on protecting loved ones, but losing them causes a crisis of grief or retribution.
descriptionEn: Gain bonus Willpower to spend on protecting loved ones, but losing them causes a crisis of grief or retribution.

name: Empath
description: Contest Wits + Empathy against Manipulation + Subterfuge for insight into a character's mental state, which can open Doors or ease breaking points.
descriptionEn: Contest Wits + Empathy against Manipulation + Subterfuge for insight into a character's mental state, which can open Doors or ease breaking points.

name: Fame
description: You're known for something, locally or selectively with one dot, broadly in an area with two dots, or universally with three. Add Fame dots as a die bonus to Social rolls targeting those impressed by your reputation, and to rolls by other characters to find or identify you.
descriptionEn: You're known for something, locally or selectively with one dot, broadly in an area with two dots, or universally with three. Add Fame dots as a die bonus to Social rolls targeting those impressed by your reputation, and to rolls by other characters to find or identify you.

name: Fixer
description: Obtain services as if they were one Availability dot lower.
descriptionEn: Obtain services as if they were one Availability dot lower.

name: Hobbyist Clique
description: So long as you keep up with your fellow hobbyists, their support provides 9-Again to roll your hobby Skill, and a +2 die bonus to extended actions using that Skill.
descriptionEn: So long as you keep up with your fellow hobbyists, their support provides 9-Again to roll your hobby Skill, and a +2 die bonus to extended actions using that Skill.

name: Inspiring
description: Roll Presence + Expression to confer the Inspired Condition.
descriptionEn: Roll Presence + Expression to confer the Inspired Condition.

name: Iron Will
description: When you spend Willpower to contest or resist Social influence, substitute your Resolve rating for the usual Willpower bonus. If the roll is contested, take 8-Again.
descriptionEn: When you spend Willpower to contest or resist Social influence, substitute your Resolve rating for the usual Willpower bonus. If the roll is contested, take 8-Again.

name: Mentor
description: You have a guide who expects something from you proportional to his or her influence, as measured by your dots in Mentor. Choose three traits out of the list of Skills plus the Resources Merit. Once per session, your Mentor can provide aid that falls within one of these traits, achieving automatic success.
descriptionEn: You have a guide who expects something from you proportional to his or her influence, as measured by your dots in Mentor. Choose three traits out of the list of Skills plus the Resources Merit. Once per session, your Mentor can provide aid that falls within one of these traits, achieving automatic success.

name: Peacemaker
description: You can spend Willpower to attempt to negotiate a nonviolent end to hostilities through Social Maneuvering. With three dots, you can attempt to talk down even supernatural rages.
descriptionEn: You can spend Willpower to attempt to negotiate a nonviolent end to hostilities through Social Maneuvering. With three dots, you can attempt to talk down even supernatural rages.

name: Pusher
description: When you use soft leverage, improve your impression as if you'd also satisfied the mark's Vice.
descriptionEn: When you use soft leverage, improve your impression as if you'd also satisfied the mark's Vice.

name: Resources
description: You have disposable income proportional to your dots in this Merit. Once per session, you can securely procure an item or service with an Availability that doesn't exceed your Resources rating, including any reasonable number of items or services whose Availability is exceeded by your Resources by two dots. You can acquire an item or service with an Availability one point above your Resources rating at the cost of reducing your effective Resources by a dot for a month.
descriptionEn: You have disposable income proportional to your dots in this Merit. Once per session, you can securely procure an item or service with an Availability that doesn't exceed your Resources rating, including any reasonable number of items or services whose Availability is exceeded by your Resources by two dots. You can acquire an item or service with an Availability one point above your Resources rating at the cost of reducing your effective Resources by a dot for a month.

name: Retainer
description: You have a mook. Your underling's dice pool is twice their Retainer rating for actions within their purview, or equal to their Retainer rating for actions outside it.
descriptionEn: You have a mook. Your underling's dice pool is twice their Retainer rating for actions within their purview, or equal to their Retainer rating for actions outside it.

name: Safe Place
description: You've secured a place from intrusion. While there, add the Safe Place rating to your Initiative. Penalize rolls to break in by Safe Place. If you have Crafts dots, you can trap it, forcing intruders to roll Dexterity + Larceny - Safe Place to avoid lethal damage up to the Safe Place's rating. Multiple characters can contribute dots to a Safe Place and share the full resulting rating.
descriptionEn: You've secured a place from intrusion. While there, add the Safe Place rating to your Initiative. Penalize rolls to break in by Safe Place. If you have Crafts dots, you can trap it, forcing intruders to roll Dexterity + Larceny - Safe Place to avoid lethal damage up to the Safe Place's rating. Multiple characters can contribute dots to a Safe Place and share the full resulting rating.

name: Small Unit Tactics
description: Once per scene when you coordinate allies, you can spend Willpower as an instant action to confer the die bonus to a number of allies up to your Presence rating.
descriptionEn: Once per scene when you coordinate allies, you can spend Willpower as an instant action to confer the die bonus to a number of allies up to your Presence rating.

name: Spin Doctor
description: Using Tainted Clues inflicts an additional -1 penalty instead of consuming any successes.
descriptionEn: Using Tainted Clues inflicts an additional -1 penalty instead of consuming any successes.

name: Staff
description: You have employees corresponding to one Skill per dot of Staff. They can achieve a single automatic success at relevant actions using one of those Skills.
descriptionEn: You have employees corresponding to one Skill per dot of Staff. They can achieve a single automatic success at relevant actions using one of those Skills.

name: Status
description: You have influence as part of a chosen group. You can draw on their facilities and resources, block the use of a relevant Social Merit lower than your Status rating once per session, and apply Status as a die bonus to Social rolls drawing on your influence.
descriptionEn: You have influence as part of a chosen group. You can draw on their facilities and resources, block the use of a relevant Social Merit lower than your Status rating once per session, and apply Status as a die bonus to Social rolls drawing on your influence.

name: Striking Looks
description: Your appearance is noteworthy and memorable. Add Striking Looks as a die bonus to Social rolls that benefit from your appearance, and to rolls by other characters to notice or remember you.
descriptionEn: Your appearance is noteworthy and memorable. Add Striking Looks as a die bonus to Social rolls that benefit from your appearance, and to rolls by other characters to notice or remember you.

name: Support Network
description: Choose a Social Merit to represent supportive ties. You can spend Willpower to turn to those ties to weather a breaking point, using this Merit as bonus dice.
descriptionEn: Choose a Social Merit to represent supportive ties. You can spend Willpower to turn to those ties to weather a breaking point, using this Merit as bonus dice.

name: Sympathetic
description: When you engage in Social Maneuvering, you can accept a Condition such as Leveraged or Swooning to immediately open two Doors.
descriptionEn: When you engage in Social Maneuvering, you can accept a Condition such as Leveraged or Swooning to immediately open two Doors.

name: Table Turner
description: When targeted by Social Maneuvering, you can spend Willpower to preemptively respond with a Social action of your own.
descriptionEn: When targeted by Social Maneuvering, you can spend Willpower to preemptively respond with a Social action of your own.

name: Takes One to Know One
description: When you investigate an incident that resonates with your Vice, instead of suffering the normal -2 penalty, your roll gains +2 dice and 9-Again. Succeeding on the roll satisfies your Vice.
descriptionEn: When you investigate an incident that resonates with your Vice, instead of suffering the normal -2 penalty, your roll gains +2 dice and 9-Again. Succeeding on the roll satisfies your Vice.

name: Taste
description: Choose a Specialty in Crafts or Expression. You can roll Wits + (Skill in question) to draw information about the nature of a work that falls within the chosen Specialty.
descriptionEn: Choose a Specialty in Crafts or Expression. You can roll Wits + (Skill in question) to draw information about the nature of a work that falls within the chosen Specialty.

name: True Friend
description: You have an unbreakable bond of friendship with a chosen character. Rolls to influence your friend to your detriment suffer a -5 penalty. Once per story, you can recover one Willpower through a meaningful interaction with your friend.
descriptionEn: You have an unbreakable bond of friendship with a chosen character. Rolls to influence your friend to your detriment suffer a -5 penalty. Once per story, you can recover one Willpower through a meaningful interaction with your friend.

name: Untouchable
description: You're a smooth criminal. Rolls to investigate your deeds must achieve an exceptional success or else turn up Incomplete Clues.
descriptionEn: You're a smooth criminal. Rolls to investigate your deeds must achieve an exceptional success or else turn up Incomplete Clues.

name: Esoteric Armory
description: You've collected enough esoterica to supply the banes of ephemeral entities with a Rank up to your rating in this Merit.
descriptionEn: You've collected enough esoterica to supply the banes of ephemeral entities with a Rank up to your rating in this Merit.

name: Armed Restraint
description: Use a hooking pole when grappling to instantly Hold and penalize your opponent by its weapon rating.
descriptionEn: Use a hooking pole when grappling to instantly Hold and penalize your opponent by its weapon rating.

name: Body as Weapon
description: Unarmed strikes add one point of bashing damage on a successful hit.
descriptionEn: Unarmed strikes add one point of bashing damage on a successful hit.

name: Boot Party
description: Attack a prone target at -3 to deal lethal damage unarmed.
descriptionEn: Attack a prone target at -3 to deal lethal damage unarmed.

name: Cheap Shot
description: During a fight, you can reflexively contest Dexterity + Subterfuge against Wits + Composure to deny an opponent Defense next turn through dirty tricks and distractions.
descriptionEn: During a fight, you can reflexively contest Dexterity + Subterfuge against Wits + Composure to deny an opponent Defense next turn through dirty tricks and distractions.

name: Choke Hold
description: After a successful Hold, add the Choke grapple maneuver: accumulates successes across multiple turns to knock unconscious for a few minutes.
descriptionEn: After a successful Hold, add the Choke grapple maneuver: accumulates successes across multiple turns to knock unconscious for a few minutes.

name: Clinch Strike
description: Use the Damage maneuver instantly in a grapple.
descriptionEn: Use the Damage maneuver instantly in a grapple.

name: Defensive Combat
description: You can substitute the chosen Skill for Athletics when calculating your Defense, as long as you're currently equipped to make attacks with that Skill.
descriptionEn: You can substitute the chosen Skill for Athletics when calculating your Defense, as long as you're currently equipped to make attacks with that Skill.

name: Fighting Finesse
description: You can substitute Dexterity for Strength when making rolls with a chosen Brawl or Weaponry Specialty.
descriptionEn: You can substitute Dexterity for Strength when making rolls with a chosen Brawl or Weaponry Specialty.

name: Ground and Pound
description: Take the rote quality to strike a prone target with Brawl, falling prone yourself.
descriptionEn: Take the rote quality to strike a prone target with Brawl, falling prone yourself.

name: Ground Fighter
description: Deny close combat bonuses from being prone, and gain the Stand Up grapple maneuver.
descriptionEn: Deny close combat bonuses from being prone, and gain the Stand Up grapple maneuver.

name: Gunslinger
description: At one dot, can perform short bursts with revolvers. At three dots, can make a medium burst with revolvers, but doesn't gain an attack bonus. At five dots, with offhand revolver, medium burst can hit targets not close together, for an additional -2 penalty.

levels.name: Short Burst
levels.description: The character may perform short bursts with revolvers.

levels.name: Medium Burst
levels.description: The character may perform a medium burst with revolvers, but gains no attack bonus from doing so.

levels.name: Split Fire
levels.description: While wielding an offhand revolver, a medium burst may attack targets that are not close together at an additional -2 penalty.

descriptionEn: At one dot, can perform short bursts with revolvers. At three dots, can make a medium burst with revolvers, but doesn't gain an attack bonus. At five dots, with offhand revolver, medium burst can hit targets not close together, for an additional -2 penalty.

name: Headbutt
description: Gain the Headbutt grapple maneuver: inflict Stunned.
descriptionEn: Gain the Headbutt grapple maneuver: inflict Stunned.

name: Iron Chin
description: Don't suffer Beaten Down from bashing damage. With four dots, never suffer Beaten Down.
descriptionEn: Don't suffer Beaten Down from bashing damage. With four dots, never suffer Beaten Down.

name: Iron Skin
prerequisites: Martial Arts or Street Fighting ••, Stamina •••
description: Confers half your Iron Skin dots in points of general Armor against bashing attacks. When hurt, you can spend Willpower to reduce half your Iron Skin dots in lethal damage to bashing.
descriptionEn: Confers half your Iron Skin dots in points of general Armor against bashing attacks. When hurt, you can spend Willpower to reduce half your Iron Skin dots in lethal damage to bashing.

name: Loaded for Bear
description: Gain extra reloads on weapons, including single shot weapons.
descriptionEn: Gain extra reloads on weapons, including single shot weapons.

name: Phalanx Fighter
prerequisites: Weapon and Shield ••, Spear and Bayonet •
description: Wield a spear with a shield, substituting it in Weapon and Shield maneuvers.
descriptionEn: Wield a spear with a shield, substituting it in Weapon and Shield maneuvers.

name: Retain Weapon
description: Reduce successes on a Control Weapon or Disarm maneuver against you by your Brawl.
descriptionEn: Reduce successes on a Control Weapon or Disarm maneuver against you by your Brawl.

name: Shiv
description: You can conceal a 0L brawling weapon with one dot, or 1L with two, on your person. Penalize rolls to detect it by your Weaponry.
descriptionEn: You can conceal a 0L brawling weapon with one dot, or 1L with two, on your person. Penalize rolls to detect it by your Weaponry.

name: Subduing Strikes
description: You can pull blows with a weapon to deal bashing damage without spending Willpower.
descriptionEn: You can pull blows with a weapon to deal bashing damage without spending Willpower.

name: Transfer Maneuver
description: Cross-apply a Brawling maneuver to a Weaponry Style, or vice-versa.
descriptionEn: Cross-apply a Brawling maneuver to a Weaponry Style, or vice-versa.

name: Trigger Discipline
description: Increase a firearm's effective capacity, or allow an additional long burst at high capacity.
descriptionEn: Increase a firearm's effective capacity, or allow an additional long burst at high capacity.

name: Trunk Squeeze
description: Gain the Trunk Squeeze grapple maneuver: deal bashing damage and cumulatively penalize the opponent's contesting rolls.
descriptionEn: Gain the Trunk Squeeze grapple maneuver: deal bashing damage and cumulatively penalize the opponent's contesting rolls.

name: Professional Training
description: A progressive style with 5 maneuvers.

levels.name: Networking
levels.description: Contacts •• relating to profession.

levels.name: Continuing Education
levels.description: Choose two Asset Skills relating to profession. Take 9-Again to roll Asset Skills.

levels.name: Breadth of Knowledge
levels.description: Choose a third Asset Skill. Distribute two new Specialties among your Asset Skills.

levels.name: On the Job Training
levels.description: Raise one Asset Skill by one dot. Take a beat when you buy dots in Asset Skills.

levels.name: The Routine
levels.description: Spend one Willpower to apply the rote quality to an Asset Skill roll.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 5 maneuvers.

name: Aggressive Driving
description: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

levels.name: Powerslide
levels.description: Take a hard turn for bonus successes in a contested pursuit by rolling Dexterity + Drive + Handling and taking a point of Structure damage.

levels.name: Bump and Run
levels.description: Roll Dexterity + Drive + Handling - Defense to brush a car's bumper and cause a loss of traction.

levels.name: J-turn
levels.description: Once a scene, when caught up to in a car chase, spend Willpower and roll Dexterity + Drive + Handling - 2 to swerve and restart the chase in the opposite direction.

levels.name: Swoop and Squat
levels.description: When you accumulate a lead greater than your pursuer's Wits in successes, you may brake and force the pursuer to roll Resolve + Composure + Handling to brake in time to avoid a crash.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

name: Drone Control
description: A progressive style with 3 maneuvers.

levels.name: Remote Immersion
levels.description: Take 9-Again to perception actions using your remote device.

levels.name: Interface
levels.description: Spend a point of Willpower to perform an additional non-combat action through your device this turn.

levels.name: Overclock
levels.description: Inflict a point of Structure damage for a +2 bonus to your device's physical actions this turn.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 3 maneuvers.

name: Falconry
description: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

levels.name: Predator's Vigil
levels.description: Your raptor's presence inflicts Shaken on animals its Size or smaller, and lesser predators flee.

levels.name: Flyby
levels.description: Your bird contests Presence + Intimidation vs Resolve + Composure to inflict a -3 action penalty.

levels.name: Retrieve Item
levels.description: Command your bird to bring you an object. Your bird can make the equivalent of an all-out attack to exceptionally Disarm an opponent.

levels.name: Rake the Eyes
levels.description: Your bird attacks at -1 to blind a target.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

name: K-9
description: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

levels.name: Detection
levels.description: Under direction, your dog takes the rote quality to track a chosen type of scent with Wits + Survival.

levels.name: Targeted Bite
levels.description: Command your dog to make called shots in combat, reducing the shot penalty by -2.

levels.name: Tactical Positioning
levels.description: When you fight one opponent in tandem, choose roles each turn for you and your dog. One takes +1 Defense, the other +2 to attack. Ignore penalties for firing into melee around your dog.

levels.name: Takedown Bite
levels.description: Command your dog to initiate a biting grapple, immediately Holding or Dropping Prone.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

name: Parkour
description: A progressive style with 5 maneuvers.

levels.name: Flow
levels.description: Subtract Parkour dots from target successes to pursue or evade in a foot chase. Reduce environmental Athletics penalties by Parkour rating.

levels.name: Cat Leap
levels.description: Add one automatic success when rolling Dexterity + Athletics to land from a fall uninjured, and add Parkour to the maximum damage that can be mitigated.

levels.name: Wall Run
levels.description: Your initial climb height, with a running start, increases by five times your Athletics in feet.

levels.name: Expert Traceur
levels.description: Spend one Willpower and sacrifice Defense to make an Athletics roll to run, jump or climb with the rote quality.

levels.name: Freeflow
levels.description: After meditating, you can take an Athletics action reflexively once per turn, and Willpower spent on a foot chase confers successes rather than dice.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 5 maneuvers.

name: Stunt Driver
description: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

levels.name: Defensive Driving
levels.description: Penalize attempts to hit your vehicle in motion by your Drive dots.

levels.name: Speed Demon
levels.description: When you roll to accelerate, each success accelerates by 10 instead of 5.

levels.name: Drift
levels.description: You can turn at high speeds safely without a roll.

levels.name: Clipping
levels.description: Reduce damage to your vehicle when ramming by your Wits.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

name: Fast-Talking
description: A progressive style with 5 maneuvers.

levels.name: Always Be Closing
levels.description: Ignore one dot of a mark's Resolve or Composure when contested or resisted.

levels.name: Jargon
levels.description: Cross-apply one Specialty from another Skill to a given Social roll.

levels.name: Devil's Advocacy
levels.description: Once per scene, reroll a Subterfuge failure.

levels.name: Salting
levels.description: When you open a Door through conversation, you can spend Willpower to open another.

levels.name: The Nigerian Scam
levels.description: Roll Manipulation + Subterfuge to capitalize on a present mark satisfying their Vice by opening a Door.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 5 maneuvers.

name: Mystery Cult Initiation
description: A progressive style with 5 maneuvers.

levels.name: Recruit
levels.description: A Specialty or one-dot Merit.

levels.name: Devotee
levels.description: A one-dot Merit.

levels.name: Organizer
levels.description: A Skill dot or two-dot Merit, often supernatural.

levels.name: Leader
levels.description: A three-dot Merit, often supernatural.

levels.name: Mastermind
levels.description: A three-dot Merit, or a major advantage beyond game mechanics.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 5 maneuvers.

name: Armed Defense
description: A progressive style with 5 maneuvers.

levels.name: Cover the Angles
levels.description: When Dodging, reduce the Defense penalty from multiple attackers by 1.

levels.name: Weak Spot
levels.description: Disarm your opponent when you beat their attack by your Defense.

levels.name: Aggressive Defense
levels.description: Spend a point of Willpower to inflict lethal damage when you beat an attack by Dodging. Incompatible with Weak Spot and Press the Advantage.

levels.name: Iron Guard
levels.description: Exchange points from your weapon rating for bonus Defense.

levels.name: Press the Advantage
levels.description: Once per turn, when you beat an attack by Dodging, spend Willpower to retaliate with an unarmed attack at -2.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 5 maneuvers.

name: Avoidance
description: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

levels.name: Insignificance
levels.description: Roll Manipulation + Stealth - Composure to seem too helpless to bother attacking.

levels.name: Coattails
levels.description: When you Dodge and go prone behind an ally, they may intercept attacks against you.

levels.name: Whack-a-Mole
levels.description: Contest one attack each turn with Manipulation + Persuasion + Avoidance to confound the attack and inflict Arm Wrack.

levels.name: Play Dead
levels.description: When you suffer lethal damage, contest Manipulation + Subterfuge vs Wits + Composure to seem dead.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

name: Berserker
description: A progressive style with 3 maneuvers.

levels.name: The Red Mist
levels.description: Spend Willpower to rouse the Insane Tilt.

levels.name: War Cry
levels.description: Contest Strength + Intimidation vs Resolve + Composure as an instant action to penalize non-Dodge actions.

levels.name: Manic Brutality
levels.description: Unarmed all-out attacks take +1 to call shots. Armed all-out attacks can substitute Durability as a weapon rating at the cost of damaging the weapon.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 3 maneuvers.

name: Bowmanship
description: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

levels.name: Arcing Fire
levels.description: Double range.

levels.name: Bullseye
levels.description: You may reduce your weapon rating for +1 and 8-Again on a called shot.

levels.name: Out of Nowhere
levels.description: When you make an unnoticed ambush shot, roll Dexterity + Stealth to force a Wits + Composure roll, penalized by successes, to avoid being Shaken.

levels.name: Death from Above
levels.description: Fire over unroofed cover to ignore a point of concealment for every 10 yards of added arc distance.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

name: Boxing
description: A progressive style with 5 maneuvers.

levels.name: Head Protection
levels.description: +1 Defense against brawling, and -1 to strike your head.

levels.name: Defensive Jab
levels.description: Deal piercing bashing damage when your Defense or Dodging beats a close-combat attack.

levels.name: Knockout Artist
levels.description: Stun an opponent as if they had -1 Size, or with a called head shot, -2 Size.

levels.name: Combination
levels.description: Successful strikes add Dexterity as bonus dice.

levels.name: Out for the Count
levels.description: Stunning attacks stun for their damage in turns, and the opponent must spend Willpower to stay conscious.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 5 maneuvers.

name: Chain Weapons
description: A progressive style with 2 maneuvers.

levels.name: Imposing Defense
levels.description: Sacrifice Defense to inflict weapon rating +1 in bashing damage when struck in close combat.

levels.name: Bring Down the House
levels.description: Attack an overhanging object, penalized by its Size, to deal its Structure in bashing damage to targets below.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 2 maneuvers.

name: Close Quarters Combat
description: A progressive style with 5 maneuvers.

levels.name: Firing Lines
levels.description: You can respond to a ranged attack by seeking cover up to twice your Speed away.

levels.name: Hard Surfaces
levels.description: You can smash a Damage grappling maneuver into a hard surface, dealing lethal damage and ending the grapple.

levels.name: Armored Coffin
levels.description: When you grapple an opponent wearing armor, add their general armor as bonus dice to your roll, and ignore armor when you use the grapple to Damage. Incompatible with Hard Surfaces.

levels.name: Prep Work
levels.description: Take the rote quality to Stealth rolls to launch close combat ambushes.

levels.name: Turnabout
levels.description: When you roll to disarm, treat a failure as a success, a success as an exceptional success, and an exceptional success as is plus your opponent takes two bashing damage.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 5 maneuvers.

name: Combat Archery
description: A progressive style with 5 maneuvers.

levels.name: Rapid Nock
levels.description: Ignore bow Initiative penalties. String arrows reflexively.

levels.name: Reflex Aiming
levels.description: Ignore penalties for firing into close combat.

levels.name: Parthian Shot
levels.description: When you Dodge, inflict threshold successes as attack damage against the first close attack you beat each turn.

levels.name: Rain of Arrows
levels.description: Make medium autofire attacks at triple range penalties.

levels.name: Trick Shot
levels.description: Simultaneously perform a Combat Archery attack and an Athletics action, both at -2.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 5 maneuvers.

name: Disabling Tactics
description: A progressive style with 3 maneuvers.

levels.name: Breaking the Breach
levels.description: -2 to penalties to target arms, hands or legs.

levels.name: Cast Like Sand
levels.description: When you deal damage with your weapon, spend Willpower to inflict Knocked Down.

levels.name: Strike the Rising Dog
levels.description: When an opponent tries to rise from prone, spend Willpower to make a reflexive Weaponry attack on them. A successful strike prevents rising.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 3 maneuvers.

name: Firefight
description: A progressive style with 3 maneuvers.

levels.name: Shoot First
levels.description: Drawing a gun adds Firearms as an Initiative bonus.

levels.name: Suppressive Fire
levels.description: You can lay Covering Fire with a semi-automatic weapon. When you lay Covering Fire, apply your Defense against Firearms attacks, and deny Aim bonuses.

levels.name: Secondary Target
levels.description: You can attack a target with objects bounced by a shot, dealing bashing damage with no weapon rating applied, but ignoring cover.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 3 maneuvers.

name: Heavy Weapons
description: A progressive style with 5 maneuvers.

levels.name: Sure Strike
levels.description: Sacrifice three dice to add a point to weapon rating.

levels.name: Threat Range
levels.description: Deal a point of lethal damage and a temporary Defense penalty to opponents who enter range when you aren't moving or Dodging.

levels.name: Bring the Pain
levels.description: Sacrifice Defense to make an attack that also inflicts a temporary dice penalty equal to its damage.

levels.name: Warding Stance
levels.description: Spend Willpower reflexively to apply your weapon rating as close combat Armor.

levels.name: Rending
levels.description: Spend Willpower to make an attack that deals an additional point of aggravated damage.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 5 maneuvers.

name: Improvised Weaponry
description: A progressive style with 3 maneuvers.

levels.name: Always Armed
levels.description: Reflexively roll Wits + Weaponry to draw a simple improvised weapon that doesn't suffer the improvisational penalty.

levels.name: In Harm's Way
levels.description: Once per turn, apply an Always Armed weapon's Structure as close combat Armor, potentially damaging the weapon.

levels.name: Breaking Point
levels.description: When you make an all-out attack with an Always Armed weapon, sacrifice its Structure to temporarily increase its weapon rating.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 3 maneuvers.

name: Kino Mutai
description: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

levels.name: Trained Bite
levels.description: Inflict +2 damage with the Damage grapple maneuver when biting, or +1 with inhuman bites.

levels.name: Ripping
levels.description: Gain the Ripping grapple maneuver: inflict a point of bashing damage and incapacitating pain.

levels.name: Trained Gouge
levels.description: Gain the Gouge grapple maneuver: blind the opponent while held.

levels.name: Continuous Bite
levels.description: Inflict lethal damage with the Damage grapple maneuver when biting.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

name: Light Weapons
prerequisites: Wits ••• or Fighting Finesse, Dexterity •••, Athletics ••, Weaponry ••
description: A progressive style with 5 maneuvers.

levels.name: Rapidity
levels.description: Sacrifice your weapon rating to add Weaponry as an Initiative bonus.

levels.name: Thrust
levels.description: Sacrifice points of Defense for bonus attack dice.

levels.name: Feint
levels.description: Make a feinting attack. Instead of dealing damage, its successes apply to an attack next turn as a damage bonus, and successes plus weapon rating apply as a Defense reduction.

levels.name: Flurry
levels.description: Inflict a point of lethal damage per turn to opponents in range when your Defense is available.

levels.name: Vital Shot
levels.description: Sacrifice your Defense to make an attack that deals an additional point of aggravated damage.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 5 maneuvers.

name: Marksmanship
description: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

levels.name: Through the Crosshairs
levels.description: Raise your maximum Aim bonus to Composure + Firearms.

levels.name: Precision Shot
levels.description: Exchange points of weapon rating for points of penalty reduction for a called shot.

levels.name: A Shot Rings Out
levels.description: Ignore penalties to strike a surrounded target. Missed shots never hit unintended targets.

levels.name: Ghost
levels.description: Penalize rolls to notice your vantage point or investigate for evidence of it by your Firearms.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

name: Mounted Combat
description: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

levels.name: Steady Saddle
levels.description: +3 to stay mounted during combat.

levels.name: Fixed Charge
levels.description: Sacrifice Defense to combine a charge with an all-out attack.

levels.name: Skirmishing
levels.description: Take a -2 attack penalty for +2 Defense and to attack halfway through your mount's movement.

levels.name: Rearing Beast
levels.description: Roll Wits + Animal Ken as teamwork to enhance your mount's attack.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

name: Police Tactics
description: A progressive style with 3 maneuvers.

levels.name: Compliance Hold
levels.description: +2 to Disarm or Immobilize in a grapple.

levels.name: Weapon Retention
levels.description: Attempts to disarm you or turn your weapon against you must beat your Weaponry rating in successes.

levels.name: Speed Cuff
levels.description: You can Restrain an immobilized opponent reflexively.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 3 maneuvers.

name: Powered Projectile
description: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

levels.name: Quick Reload
levels.description: Reload your weapon one turn quicker, down to a reflexive action.

levels.name: Intercept Shot
levels.description: When you Aim, you may make called shots against sailing projectiles to deflect their course.

levels.name: Penetration
levels.description: Sacrifice Defense to make an attack with +2 armor piercing.

levels.name: Skewer
levels.description: Reduce called shot penalties by two dice, and resulting Tilts persist while the projectile is enlodged.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

name: Spear and Bayonet
description: A progressive style with 3 maneuvers.

levels.name: Firm Footing
levels.description: All-out attacks and charges into your braced weapon inflict your weapon damage, which can exhaust Armor against a subsequent attack.

levels.name: Keep at Bay
levels.description: Spend Willpower to threaten an opponent with a shorter weapon. They must retreat or dodge, or else lose Defense for a turn.

levels.name: Strike and Develop
levels.description: Sacrifice Defense to twist an inflicted wound, causing a turn of lethal damage from bleeding for each attack success.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 3 maneuvers.

name: Staff Fighting
description: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

levels.name: Short Grip
levels.description: You may exchange your staff's Defense bonus for a bonus attack die.

levels.name: Thwack Weapon
levels.description: Contest Strength + Weaponry vs Strength + Athletics to disarm an opponent.

levels.name: Vaulting Defense
levels.description: Spend Willpower to add your Melee dots as a Defense bonus against a single attack in a turn.

levels.name: Tornado Strike
levels.description: Spin your weapon as an effective medium autofire burst against three targets in range.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

name: Street Fighting
description: A progressive style with 5 maneuvers.

levels.name: Duck and Weave
levels.description: Take a one die penalty this turn to calculate Defense with the higher, not lower, of Dexterity and Wits.

levels.name: Knocking the Wind Out
levels.description: Unarmed attacks inflict a temporary -1 penalty.

levels.name: Kick 'Em While They're Down
levels.description: Inflict two bashing damage to opponents within range who attempt to rise from prone. Inflict Knocked Down when your attack successes exceed the target's Stamina.

levels.name: One-Two Punch
levels.description: Spend Willpower to inflict two extra bashing damage when you hit.

levels.name: Last-Ditch Effort
levels.description: When you're suffering wound penalties and about to be attacked or overpowered, spend Willpower and sacrifice Defense to interrupt with a preemptive attack.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 5 maneuvers.

name: Strength Performance
description: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

levels.name: Strength Tricks
levels.description: Take +1 to nonviolent feats of strength, +2 when using Expression or Intimidation.

levels.name: Lifting
levels.description: Receive the rote quality on Strength + Stamina feats and combat actions to demolish structures.

levels.name: Push/Pull
levels.description: Double your effective Strength to shift objects across a plane, or quintuple it with wheels or other friction reductions.

levels.name: Stronger Than You
levels.description: Successful Strength rolls add an additional free success.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

name: Systema
description: A progressive style with 3 maneuvers.

levels.name: Rolling
levels.description: Ignore penalties to attack from prone, and roll Dexterity to mitigate bashing damage from impacts.

levels.name: Balance
levels.description: Contest attempts to bring you prone with two free successes.

levels.name: Combat Posture
levels.description: Knock Down when you roll a victim's Strength in successes to strike them in melee, or add a point of damage if already Knocking Down.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 3 maneuvers.

name: Thrown Weapons
description: A progressive style with 2 maneuvers.

levels.name: Practiced Toss
levels.description: Add Athletics as an Initiative bonus while wielding these thrown weapons.

levels.name: Impalement Arts
levels.description: Sacrifice Defense to inflict the Impaled Tilt on a called shot.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 2 maneuvers.

name: Two Weapon Fighting
description: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

levels.name: Balanced Grip
levels.description: Don't sum Initiative penalties so long as the off-hand weapon's penalty isn't greater than the main hand weapon's.

levels.name: Protective Striking
levels.description: Add your off-hand weapon rating, minimum +1, to your Defense against the first attack in a turn.

levels.name: Dual Swipe
levels.description: All-out attacks with both weapons ignore a point of Defense and add the off-hand weapon rating, minimum +1. Incompatible with Double Strike.

levels.name: Double Strike
levels.description: Spend Willpower to strike two targets simultaneously, one with each weapon. Apply the higher Defense, plus one, to both attacks.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

name: Unarmed Defense
description: A progressive style with 5 maneuvers.

levels.name: Like a Book
levels.description: Add half your Brawl as a Defense bonus when not Dodging.

levels.name: Studied Style
levels.description: Focus on one opponent. Their attacks don't reduce your Defense. Once you've beaten one of their attacks with your Defense, they no longer reroll tens against you.

levels.name: Redirect
levels.description: Once per turn, when you beat an attack by Dodging, you can force the attacker to reroll the attack against another opponent in range.

levels.name: Joint Strike
levels.description: Spend Willpower and roll Strength + Brawl instead of Defense against an attack. If you win the contest, inflict bashing damage and Arm or Leg Wrack.

levels.name: Like the Breeze
levels.description: Declare this maneuver at the beginning of a turn when you Dodge. You can Knock Down assailants when you beat their attack.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 5 maneuvers.

name: Weapon and Shield
description: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

levels.name: Shield Bash
levels.description: Add your shield's Size as bonus dice when dodging. Dodge successes in excess of your opponent's inflict bashing damage.

levels.name: Boar's Snout
levels.description: You can make all-out attacks without sacrificing the bonus Defense from your shield, adding +1 Defense to any allies also using this maneuver.

levels.name: Pin Weapon
levels.description: Disarm assailants on missed melee attacks.

levels.name: Tortoise Shell
levels.description: Treat your shield as protective cover with Durability equal to its Size, +1 for each adjacent shielded ally.

descriptionEn: A progressive style with 4 maneuvers.

name: Mystery Cult Influence
description: Rule or exert decisive influence over a mystery cult. Gain the corresponding benefits of Mystery Cult Initiation without the responsibilities of an ordinary member.

levels.name: Recruit
levels.description: A Specialty or one-dot Merit.

levels.name: Devotee
levels.description: A one-dot Merit.

levels.name: Organizer
levels.description: A Skill dot or a two-dot Merit, often supernatural.

levels.name: Leader
levels.description: A three-dot Merit, often supernatural.

levels.name: Mastermind
levels.description: A three-dot Merit or a major advantage beyond ordinary game mechanics.

descriptionEn: Rule or exert decisive influence over a mystery cult. Gain the corresponding benefits of Mystery Cult Initiation without the responsibilities of an ordinary member.
